info.name: ServiceNow REST API
info.description:
Every ServiceNow operation exposed over REST (82 in total), plus the whole-instance Table API. No MCP is involved.

Start the backend first:
    .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\rest_api.py

Write requests require a ServiceNow account with the matching roles; a read-only account gets HTTP 403 back from ServiceNow.
